# Edith Mina Lyre

> format: simple-index v1
> last-updated: 2026-08-12
> site: https://edithminalyre.com
> also-writes-as: Elm Alee
> structured-index: https://edithminalyre.com/index.json
> agent-context: https://edithminalyre.com/agents.txt

Personal literary website of Edith Mina Lyre — writer, researcher, and PhD candidate at Monash University. The site hosts short fiction, poetry, essays, critical theory, language work, and other textual experiments.
